title: Like-Unit Price-List Escalation on Aged Replacement Quotes — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
**Price-list notice — Homeowner Service Contracts replacements after a stalled repair.**

When Bridgewell replaces an item on a Homeowner Service Contract after a stalled repair, the replacement cost recorded on the stalled repair authorization becomes the re-priced like-unit cost by multiplying it by one plus the price-list escalation rate and rounding to the cent. The price-list escalation rate depends on the calendar days from the stalled repair authorization's date to today:

| Calendar days from the repair authorization date to today | Price-list escalation rate |
|---|---|
| more than 60 | 4% (0.04) |
| more than 30 but no more than 60 | 2% (0.02) |
| 30 or fewer | no escalation |

## Edges of each band

| Days elapsed | Band | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 30 or fewer | none |
| 31 | more than 30, no more than 60 | 2% |
| 60 | more than 30, no more than 60 | 2% |
| 61 | more than 60 | 4% |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- Recorded replacement cost 1,850.00, repair authorized 45 days ago: 1,850.00 multiplied by 1.02 is 1,887.00.
- Recorded replacement cost 1,234.56, repair authorized 75 days ago: 1,234.56 multiplied by 1.04 is 1,283.9424, rounded to the cent 1,283.94.
- Recorded replacement cost 1,850.00, repair authorized 20 days ago: no escalation; the re-priced like-unit cost is 1,850.00.

The day count runs from the date of the stalled repair authorization itself, not from the request date or the reversal date.
